data.turoyo: Komər ġalabe, komər karyole yo. Komər b lebo twiro aṯi gab u barbar. Sġəḏlele lu šulṭono w kali.
data.translation: Er wurde sehr betrübt, begab sich mit bekümmertem Herzen zu dem Barbier, fiel vor dem Sultan nieder und blieb stehen. -

summary: I.2 is the inherited impersonal feminine affect construction: an l-suffix indexes the experiencer and may be doubled by a full l-NP. The experiencer is not an ordinary agent just because the form is filed as Preterit.
Stimuli include ʕal plus a mare and a d-clause concerning speech; other contexts leave the cause implicit. Sadness, displeasure and anger fit the existing multi-part gloss and need no new senses.
The paired morəx w makre presents prolonging and shortening as alternatives with the same outcome. Its concessive effect belongs to the pairing, not an independent III verb meaning.
No occurrence supplies literal I.1 shortening, a new Detransitive form, or a new base paradigm. Preserve those inherited gaps.
The one-source pairing and the already inherited tongue command are indexed among Idiomatic phrases; neither requires renumbering or changing inherited terminology.
Is yo in karyole yo a copula, a presentational/emphatic element or part of a larger result-state construction? Preserve inherited Preterit filing pending paradigm evidence.
Does morəx w makre have a wider conventional meaning than the present concessive context? The current gloss keeps the edition’s narrower wording.
Confirm whether makrí lišonux is productive with other person/number forms before expanding the idiom beyond the inherited imperative example.
